en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a historic urban scene with multi-storey buildings featuring steep, tiled roofs and many chimneys and dormer windows. In the foreground is a walled garden and a cobblestone street with pedestrians walking along it. The architecture is late medieval/early modern Central European. Printed captions at the bottom margin read the city name on the left and a description of the building and its construction date on the right.
